follow-up time: 4-8 years (between 2009-2013 to the time of the study)
exposure: task-shifting intervention for cesarean section training
cohort: 112 healthcare professionals (41 CS surgeons, 35 anesthetic nurses, and 36 scrub nurses) trained in cesarean section in 13 hospitals in southern Ethiopia
finding: Despite significant attrition of trained staff, the task-shifting intervention in Ethiopia led to an overall increase in the number of cesarean sections performed.
